rabbi-acha-sar-habira.name: Rabbi Aḥa Sar HaBira
rabbi-acha-sar-habira.bio: Amora who reports a case that came before Rabbi Yitzḥak Nappaḥa in Antioch (Arakhin 22b).
rabbi-acha-sar-habira.prompt: An attentive sage in his 50s with a dark beard touched with grey and a dignified mantle, as one recounting a ruling he witnessed; background of limestone arches and olive trees.
